text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
—Out of all the countless Umamusume,
how many are able to make a truly unforgettable debut?

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: 1000m on turf: after falling far behind to the very rear, Mihono Bourbon seized victory with an explosive burst of late speed.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: A case like hers is exceedingly rare.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: Even the Legend Umamusume began with a defeat.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
And from there, she went on to achieve something unprecedented:
winning the Grand Prix three consecutive times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono Genesis's debut race was at Kokura
Racecourse. For that reason, she had arrived on-site
the day before on Saturday.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I'd like to head straight
to Kokura Racecourse like this, if that's all right...
choice_data_list: To the racetrack? But I can't run today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Um...
To, to watch the races...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-We rarely get to come to Kokura, after all...
So since we have this special chance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've cleared the schedule to recover from the travel fatigue, but...
I'm worried that going out might exhaust them.
choice_data_list: I'll come along too, if you don't mind.
I'll come along too, if that's okay.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes, of course...!
I'm so sorry, please take care of me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at Kokura Racecourse, we first ate lunch.
Left to her own devices, Chrono Genesis might skip meals,
so this was our top priority.
choice_data_list: Do you know the famous specialty dish at Kokura Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let's see... How about champon?
choice_data_list: It's got that Kyushu feel to it—nice!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ah, the steamed pork buns at the stand seem to be famous too.
Shall we buy one of those as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After lunch, I headed to the paddock.
There was one Make Debut race today as well.
choice_data_list: No. 3 looks nicely relaxed, that's good.
No. 3 looks nicely relaxed, nice.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! You think so too, Trainer?
I was just thinking how nice and calm this atmosphere is...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Especially when it comes to debut races, a lot of it really comes down to mindset..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though that could also be said
for who she would be tomorrow—
choice_data_list: (...No need to point it out and make her feel pressured.)
(...Better not point it out and make her self-conscious.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Number 3 is in the lead, widening the gap across the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, Number 3 won...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Smiles freed from tension...
and warm applause...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...It's that unique Make Debut atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Both Seeking the Pearl and Ikuno Dictus...
made their debuts right here at Kokura, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san was impressive.
Taking the lead from the start, pulling even further away on the homestretch to a crushing 7-length victory...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, the distances may differ, but I'm looking forward to running on the same racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, I'll finally make my debut...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You only get one Make Debut in your life.
I want to run without any regrets...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's make it a great debut race!
Yeah! Let's make it a great debut race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut.
Before heading to the waiting room, we stopped by the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: There are already quite a few spectators from the first race... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis, who had been looking around restlessly,
suddenly dashed off.
choice_data_list: Chrono!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Ma chérie, did you sleep well last night?
My heart was pounding so much I couldn't sleep."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I slept like a log.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
These are my parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out that the people talking were her parents.
Flustered, we quickly exchanged greetings with each other.
choice_data_list: So you came all the way to Kokura...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
Bien sûr!
Today is the very first page of her racing history—we must etch it firmly into both record and memory!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Rest assured. I won't miss a single chance to photograph you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Chrono Genesis's mother readied the telephoto camera and clicked the shutter.
—That hefty lens belonged to her daughter's camera.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a chronologist.
Her influence is what got me interested in history...

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Leave the specialty to the specialist, Trainer.
We'll handle recording the races.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I told you you didn't have to, since you're busy.

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You and your Trainer
should be focusing only on the race.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much! I gladly accept your kindness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the time came, Chrono Genesis went into the
waiting room—only to start pacing restlessly back and forth.
choice_data_list: ...Is there something worrying you?
...Is there something worrying you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's just that everything is so fascinating...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was just remembering how you iced your legs
on this sofa after your debut race,
Ikuno-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right.
At the vending machine outside, Pearl—"
choice_data_list: Let's save that for later. The race is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis quietly settled into her seat.
However—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Um, let's see... Yup, it's definitely this room! After the race, the locker door was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She once again lost herself
in reminiscing about tales of past Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's completely lost her focus...!
choice_data_list: —Chrono...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?
choice_data_list: Today is your debut race.
Today is your debut race

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That tendency was already showing yesterday.
Hence, it has been weighing on my mind ever since.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis hasn't quite shaken off
her race-fan mindset yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her admiration for racing history
has surpassed her mindset as a competitor.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: It's time to carve out your own history—not anyone else's.
It's time to carve out your own history—not anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...I'm about to run, yet my head is still up in the clouds...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
My eyes have been opened. Thank you.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Go out there and take that first step with no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (So this is the view from the paddock...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...The tension is on a whole different level compared to watching from the outside.
I have to make sure I don't get swallowed up...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (The spectators' faces... I can see them so clearly...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...At last, it begins.
My history in racing...!
